title: LobbyWs
description: Messages the backend pushes on the lobby WebSocket (/ws/lobby?lobbyId=…) and on the per-user WebSocket (/ws/me: a me message, and a friends message with your friends and requests). Both only push: changes go through the REST API (schema/api-v1.yaml). The server closes them with a WsCloseCode from game-ws-v1.json: 4403 after you left or were removed, 4404 after the lobby closed.

ThrowOrder.title: ThrowOrder
ThrowOrder.description: lobby: as the lobby lists people. random: shuffled for each game. bulloff: a bull off decides (games that have one).

LobbyAccess.title: LobbyAccess
LobbyAccess.description: friends: the host's friends see the lobby in Friends and join without the code. invite: only with the code, the link or an invite. The code, link and invites work under both.

LobbyPerson.title: LobbyPerson
LobbyPerson.description: A member (userId set), a guest at a member's board (userId null), or a bot (userId null, bot set), in lobby order.

addedByUserId.description: The member themselves; for a guest, who added them (and acts for them in games).

boardOwnerUserId.description: The board's owner, who can take it back.

boardMovedBy.description: Who put them on this board when it wasn't their own pick ("Moved by you").

usualBoardName.description: A member's usual board ("usually X"); null for guests.

plays.description: false: sits out the next game. Back to true after every game.

ready.description: Soft ready. After every game: false for members, true for guests.

team.description: Their team (the host sets it). Kept from game to game and while the next game is singles; when the next game is played in teams, everyone who plays has one. null: none yet.

presence.description: Members: online while they have the lobby open. null for guests.

bot.description: A bot's difficulty 1-10; null for a member or guest.

LobbyInvitee.title: LobbyInvitee
LobbyInvitee.description: A pending invite, shown after the joined people ("Waiting for X to confirm").

LobbyActivityData.title: LobbyActivityData
LobbyActivityData.description: Names as they were then. Per kind: opened, joined, left, removed, guest_added, host_changed: name. board_moved: name, userId (the person moved; null for a guest), fromBoardName, toBoardName (null = Manual). game_played: sessionId, gameId, winnerName, players. game_aborted: sessionId, gameId.

actorUserId.description: Who did it; null for game_played.

data.title: LobbyActivityData
data.description: Names as they were then. Per kind: opened, joined, left, removed, guest_added, host_changed: name. board_moved: name, userId (the person moved; null for a guest), fromBoardName, toBoardName (null = Manual). game_played: sessionId, gameId, winnerName, players. game_aborted: sessionId, gameId.

hostName.description: The host's name, as LobbySummary has it; null when the host isn't in the lobby (a host who left during a game, until it ends).

PendingInvite.title: PendingInvite
PendingInvite.description: An invite waiting for the viewer's answer (same shape as Invite in api-v1.yaml).

LobbySummary.title: LobbySummary
LobbySummary.description: The viewer's lobby for the lobby indicator.

hostName.description: Null only if the host's account is gone, or a host who left during a game hasn't been replaced yet (both settle on the next change).

youThrowNext.description: The viewer controls the seat that's up in the running game.

leg.description: The running game's leg, 0-based; null for games without legs or without a game.

youHost.description: The viewer is the lobby's host.

solo.description: Only one account is in the lobby (guests and pending invites don't count). The screens give the invite panel more room and hide ready states.

hasBot.description: At least one seat in the lobby's people is a bot: the Play page's settings form shows Bot speed.

ActiveGame.title: ActiveGame
ActiveGame.description: The viewer's running game, wherever it started (a lobby or not); LobbySummary carries that game's lobby-specific state.

lobbyName.description: The lobby it's playing in; null for a solo lobby or a game started outside a lobby.

players.description: The seat names, in seat order.

FriendsMessage.title: FriendsMessage
FriendsMessage.description: Pushed on /ws/me when it opens and whenever your friends, their status or your requests change. Same shape as GET /api/friends.

status.title: FriendStatus
status.description: What you see of a friend, first match wins: playing (seated in a running game), lobby (in an open lobby), online, offline. Only while they're online and not Invisible.

joinable.description: The lobby is open to friends and its host is your friend: join without the code

inYourLobby.description: They're in the lobby you're in (shown even while they're Invisible: you see them there anyway)

invited.description: They have a pending invite to your lobby

mutualFriends.description: Friends you both have ("3 friends in common")
